name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clauses for "Eventually pick up the blocking ball", "Eventually acquire the matching key", and "Eventually pick up the target box" are redundant because the hard Precedence constraints together with the hard Existence(door_open) and the hard Response(door_open, target_picked_up) already enforce that blocker_moved, has_door_key, and target_picked_up each occur at least once. Remove the three Existence clauses; keep the Precedence(blocker_moved, door_open), Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), Existence(door_open), and Response(door_open, target_picked_up).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clauses for hard Existence(blocker_moved), hard Existence(has_door_key) and hard Existence(door_open) are redundant. Each of these goals is already implied by the hard Precedence rules together with the hard Existence(target_picked_up). Remove the three redundant Existence clauses to match the task specification.

texts: The blocking ball must be moved away at least once.
The key that matches the door must be acquired at least once.
The door can only be opened after the blocking ball has been moved.
The door can only be opened after the key has been acquired.
The door must be opened at least once.
The target box must be picked up at least once.
The target box must be picked up only after the door is opened.
